nodes.rationale: Content-Type is client-chosen; checking prefixes stops an executable renamed to .pdf.

nodes.rationale: Upload through API validates size/type/ownership; reads via short-lived presigned URL to avoid proxying bytes.

nodes.rationale: Each account sees its leg as a normal movement; avoids touching 14 files assuming two enum values.

nodes.label: Idempotency-Key header
nodes.rationale: Transport metadata kept out of domain bodies; industry-standard name; query param rejected because it leaks into logs.

nodes.label: BaseIdempotentCommandHandler (infra/cqrs)
nodes.rationale: A global interceptor lives outside the effect's transaction, so COMPLETED could only be written after commit (unsafe variant).

nodes.label: Debt register-payment concurrent race (n+1 lost update)

nodes.label: useIdempotencyKey: one key per form-attempt
nodes.rationale: Per-request key protects nothing; per-open key breaks 'Guardar y crear otro'.

nodes.label: *WithTx refactor: handler owns the transaction
